decision_text: Stage 0 is incomplete: three of four runs were killed at the 1500 s abort (untested), so the 250/310 same-image repeat, the 200 pA count and the axon-first check were not observed. The one observed band splits: onset rows held, late-return rows missed by up to 1.72 mV (registered rejection clause met). Stage G does NOT open as registered: its gate needs a completed Stage 0 evaluation with a measured cost, and its per-evaluation cost is at least 820 + 3 x 1500 s under the observed host conditions with the 1500 s abort itself too short. The `decision` field is left null deliberately so the runner's gate stays closed until the second approval records one.

stage_g_cost_estimate.statement: One Stage G arm at four inputs costs at least 5320 s (88.7 min) under the conditions observed here, and its three active runs did not finish inside 1500 s at all; the only usable anchor for 50/53 is 649-665 s on an unshared host, which was not reproduced. Two arms concurrently would double the container load on the same host.

recommendation: Before any Stage G approval: re-run the three killed inputs of g0-b3 on an unshared host (or raise abort_seconds after measuring) to complete evaluation 1; the runner re-runs all four inputs of a candidate, so a completion costs sweep 43 again unless the runner learns per-input skipping. Judge G arms on the change of the sweep-43 late-return rows relative to +1.4 to +1.7 mV, as the rejection clause prescribes.
